title: The Ukrainian Peace Plan Written by ... Russia?

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我曾在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢单锅菜谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特惠，网址 nytimes.com slash subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: When a U.S.
sentences.zh: 当一份美国的

sentences.en: peace plan to end the war in Ukraine was leaked last week, it looked, to many, like it had been written by Russia.
sentences.zh: 旨在结束乌克兰战争的和平计划在上周被泄露时，在许多人看来，它就像是俄罗斯人写的。

sentences.en: And to a large degree, it had been.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，它确实如此。

sentences.en: And it sparked a global outcry that has forced American officials to backtrack, revise, and rethink their approach in the days since.
sentences.zh: 它引发了全球的强烈抗议，迫使美国官员在随后的几天里进行撤回、修改和重新思考他们的应对方法。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Kim Barker and David Sanger on the backroom process that led to the controversial plan and why it comes at a vulnerable moment for Ukraine's leader.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事金·巴克和大卫·萨安格将探讨促成这一充满争议的计划的幕后过程，以及为什么它恰好在乌克兰领导人极其脆弱的时刻出现。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月26日，星期三。

sentences.en: Before we start, I just have one question, Kim.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始之前，金，我只有一个问题。

sentences.en: What is that hat?
sentences.zh: 那是什么帽子？

sentences.en: Oh, this is like this crazy hat that is made of feathers.
sentences.zh: 哦，这是一顶非常疯狂的帽子，是用羽毛做的。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢它。

sentences.en: I had lost it for a long time, and I just found it.
sentences.zh: 我把它弄丢了很久，最近刚找到。

sentences.en: So that's the hat I'm wearing now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在戴的就是这顶帽子。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It looks great.
sentences.zh: 看起来真棒。

sentences.en: I couldn't tell if it was actually like one of those Soviet-type hats that is like very furry and very warm.
sentences.zh: 我一开始分不清它到底是不是那种苏联式的帽子，就是毛茸茸的那种、非常暖和的帽子。

sentences.en: It'll be coming with me back to Kiev.
sentences.zh: 我要把它带回基辅。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It's cold there, man.
sentences.zh: 那儿很冷，老兄。

sentences.en: I've heard.
sentences.zh: 我听说过。

sentences.en: Kim Barker, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 金·巴克，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks very much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So there has been a lot of news about the war in Ukraine this past week and a possible peace plan that might actually end it.
sentences.zh: 过去这一周，关于乌克兰战争以及可能真正结束战争的和平计划有很多新闻。

sentences.en: But this is not the first time that we have heard about plans to end the war.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是我们第一次听到结束战争的计划。

sentences.en: And it is kind of hard to tell at this point what is real movement and what is not.
sentences.zh: 目前确实很难分清什么是真正的实质进展，什么不是。

sentences.en: So we're turning to you to try to understand what's happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我们向你请教，以试图弄清楚究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: You've spent a lot of time in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 你在乌克兰花了很多时间。

sentences.en: You've covered the war.
sentences.zh: 你一直在报道这场战争。

sentences.en: What do you make of what has happened in the past few days?
sentences.zh: 你对过去几天发生的事情有什么看法？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's been very confusing and a bit of whiplash in Ukraine as well with what happened last Thursday when this 28-point peace plan was leaked.
sentences.zh: 是的，上周四这个28点和平计划被泄露后，乌克兰也感到非常困惑和一阵措手不及。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, everybody in Ukraine is looking at this peace plan and they're looking at every single point and saying to themselves,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，乌克兰的每个人都在看着这份和平计划，审视着每一个条款，并且心里在想，

sentences.en: this sounds an awful lot like Russian talking points, like everything Russia ever wanted.
sentences.zh: 这听起来太像俄罗斯人的说辞了，就像俄罗斯一直以来想要的一切。

sentences.en: But then at the same time, they're hearing that this is an American plan and there's a lot of pressure for Ukraine to accept it right away.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们听说这是美国的计划，而且乌克兰承受着巨大的压力，必须立刻接受它。

sentences.en: And you have to understand the situation on the ground right now.
sentences.zh: 你必须理解目前地面上的局势。

sentences.en: You've got people who are very tired of this war going on for years.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们已经对这场持续多年的战争感到极度疲惫。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of Ukrainians, if you were to ask them, they would say, yes, let's get some sort of peace deal that's not too bad for Ukraine, right?
sentences.zh: 我想很多乌克兰人，如果你去问他们，他们会说，好吧，让我们达成某种对乌克兰不算太坏的和平协议吧，对吧？

sentences.en: They would like to get something.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能得到点成果。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you've got this issue along the front lines where you've got not enough troops.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你遇到了前线兵力不足的问题。

sentences.en: And then you've got, on a nightly basis, this barrage of missiles and drones coming in and attacking civilian targets.
sentences.zh: 然后，你每天晚上还要面对连绵不断的导弹和无人机轰炸，它们袭击平民目标。

sentences.en: Given all of that, it makes total sense why Ukrainians would be so desperate to end the war.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，乌克兰人为什么会如此迫切地想要结束战争，就完全说得通了。

sentences.en: But you also mentioned this peace plan that was leaked that has seemed to, at least initially, heavily favor Russia.
sentences.zh: 但你也提到了那个被泄露的和平计划，它似乎至少在最初阶段严重偏向俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, given that, how did Ukrainians react to it?
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我想知道乌克兰人对此有何反应？

sentences.en: I mean, universally, the word that we heard over and over again was capitulation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，普遍来说，我们听到最多、反复出现的一个词就是“投降”。

sentences.en: I heard it from people who were waiting for their relatives, their dead relatives, to be taken out of this building that had been hit by missiles a couple days before.
sentences.zh: 我是从那些人那里听到这个词的，他们当时正等待着将亲人的遗体——几天前被导弹击中的建筑里的死难亲属——抬出来。

sentences.en: Capitulation.
sentences.zh: 投降。

sentences.en: And disguSt.
sentences.zh: 还有愤怒。

sentences.en: And the idea that, like, no, we have lost too much blood.
sentences.zh: 以及那种想法，即不，我们已经流了太多血。

sentences.en: But the idea that we're just going to give up everything we've been fighting for, for nothing?
sentences.zh: 但是，难道我们就这样白白放弃我们为之战斗的一切吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: And also, at the same time, you have to understand that this proposal is coming along when Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky could not be in a weaker position politically
sentences.zh: 而且与此同时，你必须明白，这项提议出现时，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基正处于其政治生涯中最软弱的时刻

sentences.en: because of this corruption scandal, you know, that's unfolded in the last couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 因为过去几周曝光的这桩腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: So tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲这个吧。

sentences.en: Where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, that story starts about 15 months ago when an investigation called Operation Midas started into a company called Energo Atom, which is this nuclear power giant in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这个故事大约始于15年前（注：原文15 months，应为15个月前），当时一项名为“迈达斯行动”的调查针对一家名为“乌克兰核能公司”（Energo Atom）的企业展开，这是乌克兰的一家核电巨头。

sentences.en: And it's a state-owned company.
sentences.zh: 它是一家国有企业。

sentences.en: And the country's anti-corruption agencies have been investigating this company for about 15 months.
sentences.zh: 该国的反腐败机构已经对这家公司调查了大约15个月。

sentences.en: They've got wiretaps of, like, more than 1,000 hours.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握了超过1000小时的监听录音。

sentences.en: And they're basically looking at key allies of President Zelensky who are accused of embezzling $100 million from this company.
sentences.zh: 他们主要在调查泽连斯基总统的核心盟友，这些人被指控从该公司贪污了1亿美元。

sentences.en: And it first comes out into public knowledge on Monday morning, November 10th, when the country's anti-corruption agencies unveiled the series of videos
sentences.zh: 这起事件首次进入公众视野是在11月10日星期一上午，当时该国的反腐机构公布了一系列视频，

sentences.en: outlining a huge corruption scheme and their investigation.
sentences.zh: 披露了一个巨大的腐败阴谋及其调查细节。

sentences.en: And then over the next two days, these videos unroll every few hours, giving more and more salacious details.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两天里，这些视频每隔几个小时就发布一次，透露出越来越多耸人听闻的细节。

sentences.en: And they feature a detective who's very well-lit, very well-produced.
sentences.zh: 视频中的侦探形象光鲜、制作精良。

sentences.en: And you're listening to it, and you're feeling like, oh, this is dramatic.
sentences.zh: 当你听着这些内容时，你会觉得，哦，这太戏剧化了。

sentences.en: Something's happening here.
sentences.zh: 这里有大动作要发生了。

sentences.en: And then you go into these sort of, like, wiretapped conversations of these people who have given themselves code names like Rocket and Sugar Man and Che Guevara and The Professor.
sentences.zh: 然后你会听到这些被监听的对话，里面的人给自己起了代号，比如“火箭”、“糖果人”、“切·格瓦拉”和“教授”。

sentences.en: And you learn through these videos that some of the money that these guys are making is coming from money that was supposed to be spent to build shelters, to protect things like
sentences.zh: 通过这些视频，你了解到这帮家伙赚到的一些钱，竟然来自于原本应该用于修建掩体的资金，而这些掩体本应用来保护诸如

sentences.en: nuclear power substations and power transformers and things like that from Russian missiles and drones.
sentences.zh: 核电变电站、电力变压器等设施免受俄罗斯导弹和无人机的袭击。

sentences.en: And each episode ends with something like, you know, more to come and to be continued.
sentences.zh: 每一集的结尾都伴随着诸如“更多精彩，敬请期待”之类的话语。

sentences.en: And it really has got Ukrainians glued to their phones.
sentences.zh: 这确实让乌克兰人目不转睛地盯着手机。

sentences.en: So it sounds like, basically, if I have this right, this anti-corruption agency is releasing almost like a mini-series about this scandal to the public?
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，如果我没理解错的话，这个反腐机构几乎是在向公众发布一部关于这起丑闻的迷你剧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I made that joke in the very beginning to an editor.
sentences.zh: 我在最开始跟一位编辑开玩笑时就说过这个。

sentences.en: I'm like, it kind of feels like Netflix.
sentences.zh: 我说，这感觉有点像网飞（Netflix）。

sentences.en: And then started looking at all the sort of social media that was being put out there, and it's exactly what Ukrainians were saying.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始浏览所有流传的社交媒体内容，发现这正是乌克兰人一直在说的话。

sentences.en: You had, like, the memes of Bill Hader eating popcorn, waiting for the next thing to drop.
sentences.zh: 你会看到诸如比尔·哈德尔吃着爆米花、等着下一出好戏上演的表情包。

sentences.en: And you had this sense that, oh, my God, is this going to actually reach the president?
sentences.zh: 你会有一种感觉，天哪，这真的会烧到总统身上吗？

sentences.en: Is this going to reach the president's chief of staff?
sentences.zh: 这会烧到总统办公厅主任身上吗？

sentences.en: Who is going to be on these tapes next?
sentences.zh: 下一个出现在这些录音带里的会是谁？

sentences.en: I'm obviously no expert in Ukrainian anti-corruption investigations, but at least in the United States, that kind of announcement would be a bit unusual.
sentences.zh: 我显然不是乌克兰反腐调查的专家，但至少在美国，这种公告会显得有些不同寻常。

sentences.en: Why would they release videos like this as opposed to just, I don't know, a press conference?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要发布这样的视频，而不是仅仅——我不知道，开个新闻发布会呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, in the States, anywhere, really, you would have a lawyer standing behind a lectern and, like, reading out the charges, or maybe they would just be filed in paper.
sentences.zh: 是的，在美国或其他任何地方，你通常会看到一名律师站在讲台后面宣读指控，或者可能只是以纸质文件形式提交。

sentences.en: You wouldn't have this sense of, like, we're going to have a promotional series of videos around our investigation before we've even brought anybody to court, right?
sentences.zh: 你不会有这种感觉，即在把任何人送上法庭之前，先围绕我们的调查推出一系列宣传视频，对吧？

sentences.en: It's very unusual.
sentences.zh: 这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the goals clearly could be to inoculate the agencies against any sort of blowback from the president's office.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中一个目的显然是为了让这些机构免受总统办公室可能带来的任何反弹。

sentences.en: They get the people on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们把民众拉到了自己这一边。

sentences.en: They get an audience, and that seemed to be happening over the first couple of days.
sentences.zh: 他们赢得了受众，在头几天里情况似乎确实如此。

sentences.en: Tell me more about that.
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: What was the reaction from Ukrainians to these videos?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人对这些视频有什么反应？

sentences.en: They were horrified.
sentences.zh: 他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: People are making money off of shelters that are supposed to protect us from Russian missile and drone attack, especially when you have us going into a winter right now
sentences.zh: 人们竟然在靠本应用于保护我们免受俄罗斯导弹和无人机袭击的掩体发财，尤其是当我们要迎来这样一个冬天时

sentences.en: where it's pretty touch-and-go with the power situation.
sentences.zh: 电力形势本就十分危急。

sentences.en: Russia has really been targeting all these places that generate power, and you've got blackouts going pretty much around the clock.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯一直在大力攻击所有这些发电场所，你几乎无时无刻不在遭遇停电。

sentences.en: So there's a sense of indignation hearing these people, hearing these men talk on these wiretaps about making money off of this.
sentences.zh: 因此，听到这些人、听到这些男子在窃听录音中谈论如何借此发财，会有一种强烈的愤慨感。

sentences.en: It's gross.
sentences.zh: 这太粗俗了。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这太令人作呕了。

sentences.en: And Ukrainians were quite upset.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人为此感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: You know, Zelensky rode into office on anti-corruption pledges, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，泽连斯基是凭借反腐承诺上台的，对吧？

sentences.en: And there is a war.
sentences.zh: 而且现在正处于战争期间。

sentences.en: There is a war that means that it's martial law.
sentences.zh: 这意味着处于戒严状态。

sentences.en: You can't elect somebody new.
sentences.zh: 你无法选举新的人选。

sentences.en: And this is their president.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的总统。

sentences.en: They want the country to hold together.
sentences.zh: 他们希望国家团结一致。

sentences.en: But for the first time, you had this sense that opposition was forming against Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 但这是第一次，你感觉到针对泽连斯基的反对力量正在形成。

sentences.en: You had the sense that the political parties were getting together.
sentences.zh: 你感觉到各个政党正在联合起来。

sentences.en: There were calls for a vote of no confidence in parliament.
sentences.zh: 议会中出现了要求举行不信任投票的呼声。

sentences.en: What has Zelensky's response been to the scandal?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基对这起丑闻有什么回应？

sentences.en: I mean, Zelensky's response to the scandal has been, look, if there's anybody, you know, guilty of corruption in this administration or anywhere they should pay in court.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，泽连斯基对这起丑闻的回应是：听着，如果本届政府或其他任何地方有人犯了腐败罪，他们就应该在法庭上付出代价。

sentences.en: Anybody who commits corruption needs to face the consequences, right?
sentences.zh: 任何犯下腐败行为的人都需要面对后果，对吧？

sentences.en: But he has not been specific about these charges.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有具体说明这些指控。

sentences.en: He's not talked about his allies who have been accused of this.
sentences.zh: 他没有谈到被指控的盟友。

sentences.en: His chief of staff, after these accusations first appeared, disappeared for more than five days, which was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 这些指控首次出现后，他的办公厅主任消失了五多天，这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: So it felt like the administration was just kind of going quiet, seeing if it was going to blow over, and then they would figure it out.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉政府只是保持沉默，看看这事能不能平息过去，然后再作打算。

sentences.en: But it was not blowing over.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有平息过去。

sentences.en: It was not blowing over at all.
sentences.zh: 根本没有平息过去。

sentences.en: It was snowballing until this peace plan leaked.
sentences.zh: 它像滚雪球一样越滚越大，直到这个和平计划被泄露。

sentences.en: And this peace plan was very beneficial to Russia.
sentences.zh: 而这个和平计划对俄罗斯非常有利。

sentences.en: In fact, it looked as if
sentences.zh: 事实上，看起来就像是

sentences.en: Russia had written some of the proposals.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人自己写下了其中的一些提议。

sentences.en: Among them,
sentences.zh: 其中包括，

sentences.en: Ukraine would never be able to join NATO, ever.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰将永远、永不被允许加入北约。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Ukraine would permanently have to have a smaller military.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰必须永久维持一支规模较小的军队。

sentences.en: Ukraine would have to cede territory that Russia hadn't even won yet.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰必须割让连俄罗斯甚至都还没有攻占的领土。

sentences.en: All of these being non-starters, basically, for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 对乌克兰来说，所有这些基本上都是无法接受的底线。

sentences.en: All of these are non-starters, especially the idea of having a smaller military.
